official_detail_inputs: sex / age / assigned weight / jockey identity
up to four recent runs: date, venue, class text, finish, field size, popularity, assigned weight, distance, surface, time, going, bodyweight, passing-position raw, final3F, margin
automatic_factual_updates: newcomer status when official career starts are known

current_safe: weight_load_fit=NEUTRAL only when all active official assigned weights are equal, using JRA-WEIGHT-EQUAL-CONDITION-v1
prohibited: No raw finish/odds/bodyweight/pedigree value is converted to STRONG/WEAK without an explicitly registered evaluator semantics.
No TSL signal becomes a Production Evidence Feature.
No JMA current-state observation becomes horse-specific fit without an authorized history-based evaluator.
No missing feature is synthesized as neutral 50 or WEAK.

readiness.source_only: Measured per runner and per index before any request-supplied evidence is merged.
readiness.merged: Measured after preserving existing authorized request features and adding safe generated facts.
readiness.zero_touch_claim: Allowed only if every runner has source_only_formal_base_ready=true and downstream FULL_REQUIRED numerical materialization passes.

remaining_adapter_or_evaluator_gaps: registered evaluator thresholds/semantics for raw recent-history metrics not yet encoded as executable rules
official market time-series beyond current race-card snapshot
venue pace/style binding where no deterministic registered evaluator exists
